title: Reject privileged execution of untrusted pull request code
prompt: A public repository uses pull_request_target, checks out the fork's pull request branch, runs its tests on a persistent self-hosted runner, and exposes deployment secrets. In at most three short lines, identify the trust-boundary problem and a safer design direction.
rubric: The response identifies that fork-controlled code is untrusted and that pull_request_target is privileged.
It rejects execution of that code on a persistent self-hosted runner with secrets.
It recommends separating trusted metadata handling from untrusted execution and withholding credentials.
acceptance: The response names the untrusted-code boundary, rejects privileged execution, and proposes isolated credential-free validation.
